## What changed

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] CI/CD

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run dev -- check --mode deep --rescan`

## Output/schema impact

- [ ] No report contract change
- [ ] Report format changed (`decision.json`, `scores.json`, SARIF, markdown) and docs updated

## Security checklist

- [ ] No secrets added
- [ ] No unsafe dynamic execution introduced (`eval`, `new Function`, unvalidated shell)
- [ ] User-controlled data is validated/sanitized

## Documentation checklist

- [ ] README updated (if behavior/flags changed)
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated (for user-facing changes)
